mechanism: Sitagliptin can increase serum potassium levels by inhibiting aldosterone secretion through GLP-1 pathway effects, particularly in patients with renal impairment or diabetes.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically in patients on sitagliptin, especially those with baseline hyperkalemia risk factors, renal disease, or concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs; adjust potassium supplementation as needed.
